claim: The AWS Shield FAQ says you need a Business or Enterprise support plan to escalate to or engage the AWS Shield Response Team (SRT); the AWS Support FAQ says Business Support stops accepting new subscriptions on December 2, 2025, with all old plans shutting down on January 1, 2027, and the current plans are Business Support+, Enterprise and Unified Operations.

qualifiers.scope: the Shield FAQ answer on SRT escalation
qualifiers.condition: AWS Support plans are in transition to Business Support+, Enterprise and Unified Operations until January 1, 2027

evidence.quote: Yes, you need a Business or Enterprise support plan in order to escalate to or engage the AWS Shield Response Team (SRT).
Business Support will stop accepting new subscriptions on December 2, 2025.
Throughout 2026, AWS will manage phased transitions for existing customers, with all old plans officially shutting down on January 1, 2027.
Customers who desire a deeper level of support can subscribe to AWS Support at the Business Support+, Enterprise, or Unified Operations level.

note: d124; shield#33. Adjudicated 2026-10-12: the Shield FAQ and the Shield Advanced guide still name Business or Enterprise; no saved Shield page names Business Support+ yet. Writers: teach the SRT support-plan requirement with this transition note; older exam questions say Business or Enterprise.
